transcript.text: Are you a parent who wants to see their child become a founder or a CEO? Then this is for you. In Mesa's undergrad program in business and entrepreneurship, students don't just learn things, they build real businesses and generate real revenue. In the duration of this program, your child will launch a real product, run marketing, build AI workflows, figure out supply and demand, build a team and sell products to real customers. And to help with all of this, they will get one-on-one mentorship from startup founders and operators. If this is something that excites you, you should apply now.
